name: Instruction Query Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of instruction queried.

SETT.name: Settlement Instruction
SETT.definition: Query is performed on settlement transactions.

IPOS.name: Intra Position Movement
IPOS.definition: Query is performed on intra-position movements.

BOTH.name: Settlement And Intra Position
BOTH.definition: Query is performed on both settlement transactions and intra-position movements.
